## Security verdict: PASS

PR #228 at **b0259b1987d3f829e5494cefa9e366d07404544b**, one round under C33/C34. Reviewed the eight-file delta and relevant wrapper/test context against the F186 ruling.

`shared-build.sh:173-186,364-367` preserves arguments through `%q` serialization and quoted `"$@"`; exact `--then` separates commands, with empty-command refusal. Dispatch uses a quoted nice array (`342-367`). Removing the taskpolicy seam and automatic no-run split adds no replacement arbitrary-wrapper lookup or new unquoted command construction.

The route-inventory wrapper uses fixed `/usr/bin/nice -n 19 cargo test ...` rather than interpolated command text (`justfile:254-255`). Job/thread exports, disk floor, private atomic lock, stale-lock handling, draining, `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0` and per-command floor checks remain (`shared-build.sh:125-126,273-330,357-365`).

The scheduling test asserts nice-only execution even with the retired taskpolicy seam supplied (`harness/scripts/shared-build.test.ts:272-312`). Its `$*` logging does not separately prove byte-for-byte argv boundaries; those were source-reviewed. No new daemon or recurring-loop behavior was identified in this change.
